purpose: Royal Throne gameplay asset and sound polish v2

images.brief: Original smooth 3D cyan and royal-blue faceted currency gem, readable at small sizes, transparent background.
Compact three-lobe sculpted white puff, soft cool shading, clean silhouette, transparent background. Short game impact, no cinematic smoke cloud.
Smooth stylized royal crystal ice tile, pale blue beveled edges, readable match-three obstacle, transparent background.
Original polished gold royal key, simple 3D silhouette and rounded bevels, isolated transparent background.
Gold crossing chains with central royal blue padlock, smooth 3D board obstacle, transparent background.
Royal slate stone block with shield relief, smooth stylized 3D rounded square, unbreakable obstacle, transparent background.

imageProcessing: Fit inside 256x256, WebP quality 85, alpha quality 100, effort 6; preserve source transparency. Editor importer produces compressed Unity textures in Library.
reused: heart, star, coin, chest and settings derive from the approved original RoyalBlue-Home-v1 assets. Match pieces, powers, king and castle retain the established original Royal Throne style.

requests.prompt: One single close-miked small glazed ceramic jewel snapped and tapped onto polished stone. Immediate dry chunky tok-crack with tiny bright glass chips, satisfying tactile game match impact. Very short 180 millisecond decay. No music, no voices, no beeps, no long whoosh, no reverb.

One compact pressurized firework barrel burst for a puzzle game. Immediate sharp wooden crack layered with punchy bass thump, airy white puff, 4 tiny debris ticks. Dry close perspective. Full-bodied playful impact, no huge cinematic sub-bass, no ringing, no music, no voices, tail under half second.

One small brass mechanical rocket ignites with a crisp click and bright compressed air snap, accelerates rapidly left to right with an energetic narrow jet hiss and ends in a short pop. Dry close game sound, 0.6 seconds active sound, no music, no sci-fi tones, no cinematic rumble.

One miniature mechanical brass propeller spins up fast with tactile ratcheting ticks and a fluttering rotor buzz, then a tiny pneumatic impact pop. Crisp close puzzle game action, no real helicopter ambience, no music, no voices, quick clean decay.

audio.mastering: master-sfx-v2.cjs: onset trim, high-pass filtering, transient EQ, short fade, limiter, 32 kHz mono PCM sources. Unity ADPCM runtime import. Landing/UI contacts derive from the second match take.

music.status: Unchanged: source bytes, import settings, volume, loop/crossfade and music preference logic.

references: User-supplied Royal Match recordings reviewed for compact flashes, localized sparkle trails and rapid board recovery. No competitor frames or sound samples are installed.
